@graph.howPerformed: Your dermatologist first assesses your condition and skin type to set a safe starting dose. During each short session, the affected skin is exposed to controlled UV light while your eyes are protected. The dose is adjusted gradually as your skin responds, and sessions are usually repeated over several weeks.

acceptedAnswer.text: Under dermatologist supervision with carefully controlled doses, phototherapy is considered safe. Mild redness, like a light sunburn, can occur.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most conditions need a series of sessions over several weeks. Your dermatologist will set a schedule based on how your skin responds.
